title: Learning brain dynamics across distinct scaling regimes reveals psychiatric signatures
abstract: Introduces Multi-Band Brain Net (MBBN), a transformer-based framework that decomposes fMRI signals into biologically grounded frequency bands, achieving state-of-the-art prediction of psychiatric and cognitive outcomes (major depressive disorder, ADHD, autism spectrum disorder) across 49,673 individuals from UK Biobank, ABCD, and ABIDE.
